overview_description.description:
BuildBuddy provides enterprise features for Bazel, an open-source build system that allows users to build and test software. It captures build logs, invocation details, target information, and artifacts so users get a complete picture of each build. 

The company was founded by Siggi Simonarson and is headquartered in Palo Alto, California.

about_short_description.short_description: BuildBuddy provides enterprise features for Bazel, an open-source build system that allows companies to build and test software faster.

product.name: Remote Build Execution (RBE)
product.description: A cloud service that runs build and test actions in parallel across thousands of worker nodes to speed up software builds.

product.name: Remote Build Cache
product.description: A scalable, globally distributed cache that stores build artifacts to speed up subsequent builds by avoiding redundant work.

product.name: Build & Test UI
product.description: A user interface that provides visibility into build and test results, including logs, invocation details, and performance metrics.

product.name: BuildBuddy CLI
product.description: A command-line interface built on Bazelisk that supports plugins, authentication, and handles flaky network conditions for Bazel builds.

product.name: Workflows
product.description: A continuous integration system designed specifically for Bazel to provide fast CI runs by maintaining warm Bazel instances.

product.name: Customer Managed Encryption Keys
product.description: A feature allowing customers to provide their own encryption keys to secure build cache data stored by BuildBuddy.
